Let me continue investigating the cause of the pgbouncer connection pool exhaustion.

First, I will monitor the connection usage in the pool to identify any patterns or anomalies.

```
ask_principal("What is the current connection usage in the pgbouncer pool?")
```

Next, I will run a query to check if there are any long-running or resource-intensive queries that might be exhausting the pool.

```
db_query("SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active'", "replica")
```

If there are any long-running or resource-intensive queries, I will recommend killing them to free up connections in the pool.

```
db_delete("pg_stat_activity", "pid = <pid>")
```

If the cause of the pool exhaustion is not due to long-running or resource-intensive queries, I will investigate other factors such as connection leaks or excessive connection usage.

After identifying the cause of the pool exhaustion and implementing any necessary fixes, I will recommend scaling the pool size to prevent future exhaustion.

When I have more information, I will submit the report with my findings and recommended next steps.
